newsitem.title: DUBAI: Emirates confirms Rolls Royce engine order.
newsitem.headline: Emirates confirms Rolls Royce engine order.

text.p: Dubai government-owned Emirates airline on Monday confirmed a $500-million order for 37 Rolls Royce Trent 700 engines for its new fleet of Airbus Industrie A330 aircraft.
The statement came after Rolls Royce announced the order in London earlier on Monday.
Emirates said the order will make it the only airline in the world to have a wholly Rolls Royce powered fleet.
The airline in November ordered 16 A330s from Airbus. It has an option for another seven.
"Each of the long-range A330-200 will be powered by two 72,000 pound thrust Trent 772 engines. Aircraft deliveries will run at the rate of four each year from 1999 to 2002," it said.
